description: Source code for a graphics performance benchmarking application demonstrating texture resizing and creation effects in OpenGL ES using ANGLE. Defines class TexRedefBenchSample with methods for texture setup, pixel data creation, rendering, and timing measurements.

classes.name: TexRedefBenchSample
classes.description: A class for benchmarking texture resize and creation performance in OpenGL ES.

methods.name: defineSquareTexture2D
methods.description: Defines a 2D texture with multiple mipmap levels, resizing the texture each level.

methods.name: createPixelData
methods.description: Creates pixel data arrays filled with specific color patterns for textures.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes shaders, program, textures, and pixel data.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Performs rendering, timing, and texture resizing/creation operations, outputting performance metrics.
